rules: Roommate is a derived co-residency relation from sharing one current quarters unit.
Roommate assignment cannot be based on desired story chemistry, romance potential or player convenience.
Species, culture, gender, personality, branch or social status are not automatic roommate partitions.
An explicit Academy policy may constrain housing only when represented in configuration/content and compatible with project canon/policy.
Hard accessibility, medical, environmental or safety constraints outrank convenience and soft preferences.
A single-occupancy requirement must use actual single-capacity housing or remain unresolved.
Existing valid assignment persists until an explicit move/reassignment event.
Sharing quarters does not create friendship, trust, affection, resentment or romance automatically.
Later lived events in shared quarters may affect relationships through the social system.
Roommates do not have to share identical schedules; schedule arbitration is Step 5.
